name: New CAN ID / decoding
about: Share a CAN ID or signal you decoded (or a correction)
title: "[CAN ID] 0x___ — <signal>"
labels: can-id
---

**Vehicle**: model year, engine, body type (van / chassis cab / motorhome), market
**Bus / bitrate**: e.g. body CAN on OBD 6/14, 50 kbit/s
**CAN ID**: 0x___  **DLC**:  **Rate**: __ Hz

**Signal and decoding**
e.g. `b2` bit 4 = rear fog light

**How it was verified**
e.g. switched it on/off 3 times, value followed each time

**Sample frames** (before / after)
```
t___8 ...
t___8 ...
```

- [ ] No VIN, plate, GPS or passwords in the data above
